title: 第二十一章 我能进去吗？
novel_title: 魔头别夺舍了，我们正道快没人了
content_zh:
望着门口的白洁，季南北心念急转。

    她为何会出现在此?

    莫不是出行游历之期临近，特意前来寻衅滋事?

    想来多半如此。

    但季南北依旧不解:在这仙灵剑宗之内，怎会有人胆敢公然对萧京溪不利?

    莫非“小剑仙”之名只是虚传?

    在仙灵剑宗，萧京溪可是年轻一辈中地位最尊、实力最强、背景最深厚的存在，谁惹谁就得吃苦头才对。

    思及此处，季南北便不再多虑。

    兵来将挡，水来土掩便是。拥有绝对的实力时，本无需顾虑太多。

    只是季南北并未察觉，自白洁现身起，萧京溪的情绪便有些飘忽不定。

    “白师妹，有事么?“

    季南北开口道，面上仍是那招牌式的浅笑，目光直直落在白洁身上，带着几分审视意味。

    只是

    似乎有些不对劲。

    这人怎么被自己盯着，非但不露怯意，反倒显得格外兴奋?

    嗯?

    是我小剑仙提不动剑了，还是你胆子太肥了?

    “师姐......你唤我白师妹?”

    白洁低着头，轻声说道。季南北疑惑。

    不叫你白师妹，难不成叫你“孽畜”吗?

    眼下又没到撕破脸的地步。

    “正是......“

    “师姐能让我进去坐坐吗!”

    季南北话音未落，眼前的少女忽地凑近，双眼亮晶晶地直盯着他。

    季南北:???

    这孩子是不是哪里不太对劲?

    这找茬的方式怎如此古怪。

    难道.....

    季南北瞥向院外，远处确有数名仙灵剑宗弟子往来行走。

    此处虽属萧京溪独居小院，但离宗门主路不远，若朝这边张望，仍能瞧见此处动静。原来如此打算先示弱令我放松警惕，诱我进入无人目击的院内，再伺机动手或设计陷害么?
content_en:
Looking at Bai Jie at the door, Ji Nanbei's thoughts changed rapidly.

    Why does she appear here?

    Could it be that the time for travel is approaching and I came here specifically to cause trouble?

    I think that's probably the case.

    But Ji Nanbei was still puzzled: How could anyone in the Immortal Sword Sect dare to openly be detrimental to Xiao Jingxi?

    Could it be that the name "Little Sword Fairy" is just a false rumor?

    In the Immortal Sword Sect, Xiao Jingxi is the one with the most respectable status, the strongest strength, and the deepest background among the younger generation. Anyone who messes with him will have to suffer.

    Thinking about this, Ji Nanbei stopped worrying about it.

    When the soldiers come, they will block it, and when the water comes, the earth will cover it. When you have absolute strength, you don't need to worry too much.

    However, Ji Nanbei didn't notice that since Bai Jie appeared, Xiao Jingxi's mood became a little erratic.

    "Junior sister Bai, is something wrong?"

    Ji Nanbei said, with the signature smile still on his face, his eyes falling directly on Bai Jie, with a hint of scrutiny.

    Just

    Something seems wrong.

    Why was this person staring at him, so instead of showing any timidity, he actually looked particularly excited?

    Huh?

    Is it that my little swordsman can’t lift the sword, or are you too brave?

    "Senior Sister...you call me Junior Sister Bai?"

    Bai Jie lowered her head and said softly. Ji Nanbei was confused.

    If I don’t call you Junior Sister Bai, is it possible to call you an “evil beast”?

    Now it's not to the point of breaking up.

    "Exactly..."

    "Sister, can you let me come in and sit down?"

    Before Ji Nanbei finished speaking, the girl in front of him suddenly came closer and stared at him with bright eyes.

    Ji Nanbei:???

    Is there something wrong with this child?

    Why is this way of finding trouble so weird?

    Could it be...

    Ji Nanbei glanced outside the courtyard and saw several disciples of the Immortal Sword Sect walking back and forth in the distance.

    Although this place belongs to the small courtyard where Xiao Jingxi lives alone, it is not far from the main road of the sect. If you look this way, you can still see the movement here. Is this the plan to show weakness first to make me relax my vigilance, to lure me into the courtyard where no one is witnessing, and then to plan a move or frame me?
